title: Grilled Lentil Skewers with Arabian Spice
description: Inspired by Japanese flavors, these skewers combine the taste of Arabian spice with the simplicity of grilled lentils. A unique and delicious twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.
instructions: 1. Soak the red lentils in water for 30 minutes. Drain and rinse.
2. Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
3. Thread a lentil, a date, and an onion slice onto each skewer.
4. Brush the skewers with grill oil and season with Arabian spice blend.
5. Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
6. Brush with soy sauce during the last minute of grilling.
7. Serve hot, garnished with a drizzle of rice vinegar if desired.
